human_feedback.interpretation: Character recognition remains correct, but the macro vector re-authoring does not create a meaningful design-quality improvement.

reason: The project has now shown that both local and macro scripted vector deformation can preserve correctness and alter geometry, but they do not materially raise design quality. Continuing path-warp parameterization would repeat low-value taste iteration.
